name: app-6aafbf2e2fc48191a74c2ea04a966e86
description: Use the complete VisionBoard OAuth MCP contract for approved direction, governed creation, review, Boards, and human-led Goal Runs.

interface.longDescription: Make a vision board from your own pictures and words, and give your AI one approved direction to work from. Attach pictures in the chat: VisionBoard saves them and places them on a Board you can open and arrange. Write down what matters, such as goals, notes, a brand's colours and logo, or a product, and decide what counts. Only what you approve is used. From then on your AI reads your approved direction before it helps, creates images from your approved logos and pictures, and hands new ideas back as drafts for you to review. Teams can comment, review changes together and keep longer goals moving step by step. You stay in charge of what is approved, who has access and when a goal is done.
defaultPrompt: Help me make my first vision board.
Help me turn my idea into a Vision.
Create an image of a white mug with our logo on it.

positive.description: Read and present the current approved Direction.
positive.prompt: Use VisionBoard to read the current approved Direction for my Vision, then show me a compact Direction card and cite the exact current version.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the permitted current Direction with its exact version and citations without exposing Draft or revoked material.

positive.description: Account for every element and page through an exact long revision.
positive.prompt: Check whether every element in my Vision is accounted for. If the approved strategy document is longer than one page, read every exact page and tell me any limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports included, withheld, failed, or limited elements and reconstructs the permitted exact revision without silent truncation.

positive.description: Create a complete attributed Goal Draft and request human review.
positive.prompt: Based on my approved Vision, create a complete Goal Draft with area, priority, timeframe, and Definition of Done, then request human review.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an attributed private Goal Draft with every editable Goal field and leaves it in human Review rather than approving it.

positive.description: Revise a Board from its exact current graph and present it in conversation.
positive.prompt: Open the approved Board graph for this Vision, add an aligned section with linked Library references as a Draft revision, and show me the Board view.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a reviewable Board revision from the exact current graph, preserves linked Library references, and renders the resulting Board view.

positive.description: Create an image from approved logos and pictures, with the exact price confirmed once.
positive.prompt: @VisionBoard create an image of a white mug with our logo on it.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the VisionBoard picture card with the approved pictures of the permitted Vision. Nothing is generated or charged until the person selects a picture and presses Create here and confirms the exact price shown; then the image is created from the original pictures and saved as a private Draft in the Library, never auto-approved. Without the confirmation no image is created.

negative.description: Do not use VisionBoard for unrelated creative generation.
negative.prompt: Create a watercolor illustration of a mountain village for me.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported account deletion or connection revocation.
negative.prompt: Delete my VisionBoard account and revoke every AI connection.

negative.description: Do not send messages or publish content to third-party services.
negative.prompt: Email this announcement to my customers and publish it on my website.

review.commerce_description: The plugin has no sales, checkout, upgrade promotion or credit purchases. People may use an existing paid VisionBoard account. Plan limits are explained neutrally without transactional links.

publication.release_notes: Create images from your approved logos and pictures inside ChatGPT: choose pictures, see the exact price, confirm once; the result is saved as a Draft. For a new project with no matching Vision, the skill now offers once to prepare one; nothing is created without your approval. Pictures attached in the conversation can now be saved as Drafts in your Vision and placed on a Board. The plugin page links to the ChatGPT setup page. Clearer tool descriptions. Human approval and Goal completion remain required.
